mapper.sql: SELECT h.*, p.title AS place_title, p.address AS place_address, p.thumbnail AS place_thumbnail FROM hotel_profiles h JOIN places p ON p.id = h.place_id
SELECT b.*, p.title AS hotel_name FROM hotel_bookings b JOIN hotel_profiles h ON h.id = b.hotel_id JOIN places p ON p.id = h.place_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hotel_profiles (id, organization_id, place_id, property_code, property_type, star_rating, description, check_in_time, check_out_time, timezone, amenities, languages, reception_hours, house_rules, accessibility_features, parking_details, policies, booking_contact, status, disabled_reason, data_version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{placeId}, #{propertyCode}, #{propertyType}, #{starRating}, #{description}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{timezone}, #{amenities}::jsonb, #{languages}::jsonb, #{receptionHours}::jsonb, #{houseRules}::jsonb, #{accessibilityFeatures}::jsonb, #{parkingDetails}::jsonb, #{policies}::jsonb, #{bookingContact}::jsonb, #{status}, #{disabledReason}, #{dataVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE hotel_profiles SET property_code=#{propertyCode}, property_type=#{propertyType}, star_rating=#{starRating}, description=#{description}, check_in_time=#{checkInTime}, check_out_time=#{checkOutTime}, timezone=#{timezone}, amenities=#{amenities}::jsonb, languages=#{languages}::jsonb, reception_hours=#{receptionHours}::jsonb, house_rules=#{houseRules}::jsonb, accessibility_features=#{accessibilityFeatures}::jsonb, parking_details=#{parkingDetails}::jsonb, policies=#{policies}::jsonb, booking_contact=#{bookingContact}::jsonb, status=#{status}, disabled_reason=#{disabledReason}, data_version=data_version+1, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND data_version=#{dataVersion}
mapper.select: JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=h.organization_id WHERE h.id=#{id} AND h.status='ENABLED' AND p.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND o.operational_status='ENABLED' AND o.verification_status='VERIFIED'
WHERE h.organization_id=#{organizationId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE room_types SET code=#{code},name=#{name},description=#{description},max_adults=#{maxAdults},standard_adults=#{standardAdults}, max_children=#{maxChildren},max_infants=#{maxInfants},max_occupancy=#{maxOccupancy},bedroom_count=#{bedroomCount}, bathroom_count=#{bathroomCount},view_type=#{viewType},bathroom_type=#{bathroomType},smoking_allowed=#{smokingAllowed}, bed_config=#{bedConfig}::jsonb,amenities=#{amenities}::jsonb,accessibility_features=#{accessibilityFeatures}::jsonb, images=#{images}::jsonb,room_size_sqm=#{roomSizeSqm},total_units=#{totalUnits},status=#{status}, disabled_reason=#{disabledReason},data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND data_version=#{dataVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM room_types WHERE hotel_id=#{hotelId} AND status='ENABLED' ORDER BY created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE rate_plans SET code=#{code},name=#{name},description=#{description},currency=#{currency},base_price=#{basePrice}, pricing_model=#{pricingModel},base_occupancy=#{baseOccupancy},extra_adult_fee=#{extraAdultFee},extra_child_fee=#{extraChildFee}, meal_plan=#{mealPlan},included_benefits=#{includedBenefits}::jsonb,cancellation_policy=#{cancellationPolicy}::jsonb, prepayment_policy=#{prepaymentPolicy}::jsonb,no_show_policy=#{noShowPolicy}::jsonb, occupancy_pricing=#{occupancyPricing}::jsonb,min_stay=#{minStay},max_stay=#{maxStay}, min_advance_days=#{minAdvanceDays},max_advance_days=#{maxAdvanceDays},refundable=#{refundable}, status=#{status},data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND data_version=#{dataVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rate_plans WHERE room_type_id=#{roomTypeId} AND status='ENABLED' ORDER BY created_at
SELECT * FROM rate_plan_daily_rates WHERE rate_plan_id=#{ratePlanId} AND rate_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY rate_date
mapper.insert: WITH dates AS (SELECT generate_series(#{startDate}::date, #{endDate}::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day) INSERT INTO room_inventory_daily (room_type_id,inventory_date,total_units,reserved_units,sold_units,blocked_units, stop_sell,price_override,min_stay,closed_to_arrival,closed_to_departure,data_version,updated_by,updated_at) SELECT r.id,d.day,COALESCE(#{totalUnits},r.total_units),0,0,COALESCE(#{blockedUnits},0),COALESCE(#{stopSell},false), NULL,NULL,false,false,1,#{updatedBy},#{updatedAt} FROM room_types r CROSS JOIN dates d WHERE r.id=#{roomTypeId} AND COALESCE(#{blockedUnits},0) <= COALESCE(#{totalUnits},r.total_units) ON CONFLICT (room_type_id,inventory_date) DO UPDATE SET total_units=COALESCE(#{totalUnits},room_inventory_daily.total_units), blocked_units=COALESCE(#{blockedUnits},room_inventory_daily.blocked_units), stop_sell=COALESCE(#{stopSell},room_inventory_daily.stop_sell), data_version=room_inventory_daily.data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE room_inventory_daily.reserved_units + room_inventory_daily.sold_units + COALESCE(#{blockedUnits},room_inventory_daily.blocked_units) <= COALESCE(#{totalUnits},room_inventory_daily.total_units) AND room_inventory_daily.data_version=COALESCE((CAST(#{expectedVersionsJson} AS jsonb)->>room_inventory_daily.inventory_date::text)::bigint,-1)
mapper.select: SELECT i.inventory_date,(i.total_units-i.reserved_units-i.sold_units-i.blocked_units) AS available_units, (i.stop_sell OR COALESCE(rd.stop_sell,false)) AS stop_sell, COALESCE(rd.closed_to_arrival,false) AS closed_to_arrival, COALESCE(departure_rate.closed_to_departure,false) AS closed_to_departure, COALESCE(rd.min_stay,rp.min_stay) AS min_stay,COALESCE(rd.max_stay,rp.max_stay) AS max_stay, COALESCE(rd.min_advance_days,rp.min_advance_days) AS min_advance_days,COALESCE(rd.max_advance_days,rp.max_advance_days) AS max_advance_days, COALESCE(rd.price,rp.base_price) AS nightly_price,rp.currency FROM room_inventory_daily i JOIN room_types r ON r.id=i.room_type_id JOIN rate_plans rp ON rp.id=#{ratePlanId} AND rp.room_type_id=r.id JOIN hotel_profiles h ON h.id=r.hotel_id JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=h.organization_id JOIN places p ON p.id=h.place_id LEFT JOIN rate_plan_daily_rates rd ON rd.rate_plan_id=rp.id AND rd.rate_date=i.inventory_date LEFT JOIN rate_plan_daily_rates departure_rate ON departure_rate.rate_plan_id=rp.id AND departure_rate.rate_date=i.inventory_date+1 WHERE h.id=#{hotelId} AND r.id=#{roomTypeId} AND h.status='ENABLED' AND r.status='ENABLED' AND rp.status='ENABLED' AND o.operational_status='ENABLED' AND o.verification_status='VERIFIED' AND p.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND i.inventory_date >=#{checkIn} AND i.inventory_date <#{checkOut} AND (COALESCE(rd.min_advance_days,rp.min_advance_days) IS NULL OR #{checkIn}::date-CURRENT_DATE >= COALESCE(rd.min_advance_days,rp.min_advance_days)) AND (COALESCE(rd.max_advance_days,rp.max_advance_days) IS NULL OR #{checkIn}::date-CURRENT_DATE <= COALESCE(rd.max_advance_days,rp.max_advance_days)) ORDER BY i.inventory_date
WHERE b.booking_status='PENDING_PARTNER_CONFIRMATION' AND b.hold_expires_at<=#{now} ORDER BY b.hold_expires_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.*,r.name AS room_type_name,rp.name AS rate_plan_name FROM hotel_booking_items i JOIN room_types r ON r.id=i.room_type_id JOIN rate_plans rp ON rp.id=i.rate_plan_id WHERE i.booking_id=#{bookingId}
WHERE b.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE hotel_bookings SET booking_status='EXPIRED',cancellation_reason='Partner confirmation deadline expired',cancelled_at=#{now},data_version=data_version+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND booking_status='PENDING_PARTNER_CONFIRMATION' AND data_version=#{expectedVersion} AND hold_expires_at<=#{now}
